::: {#def-risk-ratio}
#### Risk ratio (also called the relative risk)

Let:

- $\risk_1$ be the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) of a binary outcome in group 1.
- $\risk_2 > 0$ be the risk of the same outcome in the reference group, group 2.

The **risk ratio**, also called the **relative risk**, of group 1 compared with group 2 is
[@wikipedia_relative_risk]

$$\riskratio \eqdef \frac{\risk_1}{\risk_2} \in [0, \infty).$$
:::
